summary: AutoGPT's only harness-backed published results are engineering measurements: docs/engineering/frontend-perf-baseline.md records `pnpm perf` medians for 19 frontend scenarios from the committed scripts/perf harness, e.g. 209,396 renders and 5,709 ms of script time for one streamed copilot reply. Its one outcome evaluation, a 2026-10-19 Graphiti memory-extraction comparison (migrated Luna prompts 131/137 adjudicated checks and 125/137 facts-only, vs 129/137 and 79/137 for the original prompts and 132/137 and 104/137 for gpt-4.1-mini), commits scores and a per-probe CSV but states that the local harness is not committed. The classic direct-benchmark agent harness, a k6 load-test suite and a transcription WER eval ship without results (agbenchmark reports were deleted on 2026-04-03, leaving a 31-entry beaten-challenge list of unrecorded provenance), and a changelog '34%' tool-schema token reduction has no in-repo evidence.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
